literal: Firm-heart those-without will-embrace in-other-heart feigning those-who-unite's shoulders.
translation: Only men lacking a firm heart will embrace the shoulders of women who unite physically while harboring ulterior motives in their hearts.
modern: மன உறுதி இல்லாதவர்கள் மட்டுமே, உள்ளத்தில் வேறு நோக்கத்தை வைத்துக்கொண்டு உடலால் மட்டும் கூடும் பெண்களின் தோள்களைத் தழுவுவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the lack of self-control in men who seek the company of wanton women. The phrase 'piṟa neñcil' (in a different heart) refers to the women's ulterior motive, usually financial gain, which contrasts with their outward show of affection. Only men without 'niṟai neñcam' (a firm, self-controlled mind) will fall for such feigned embraces.
